classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the rectangle diagonal as the hypotenuse and apply the taught shorter-side Pythagoras calculation; a single standard right triangle is supplied.

content.prompt: A rectangle has width 9 cm and diagonal 41 cm as shown below. What is its length?

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with a diagonal from bottom left to top right. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered in house black.
spec.mathematics: The diagonal is 41 cm, the right side is 9 cm, and the bottom side is b cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original givens and unknown label are visible.

answer.worked:
By Pythagoras’ theorem:
$$\begin{align*}b^2+9^2&=41^2\\b^2+81&=1681\\b^2&=1681-81\\b^2&=1600\\b&=\sqrt{1600}\\b&=40\end{align*}$$
The rectangle's length is $40\text{ cm}$.
